purpose: Give future Astra/Codex research one leakage-aware map of the already recovered MAEVE evidence, repo-native CFGI materializations, provider-availability metadata, genuine gaps, and preferred multi-timeframe research ladder without copying restricted provider values into the public control plane.

caveats: Exact raw and normalized provider values remain private.
cfgi_score_entry is currently the cleanest recovered entry-time CFGI field.
analisis_hora and recovered impulse/volatility/volume sub-score columns are look-ahead suspect until timestamp semantics are resolved.
DCA-adjusted position success must not be equated with first-entry signal accuracy.

datasets.research_role: Proves provider-side historical availability by symbol/timeframe; does not prove the full range is stored locally.
caveats: No CFGI history before 2022 is supported by this evidence.
Native 2h coverage is not proven here.

Immutable point-in-time 4h forward evidence and future walk-forward validation lane.

Existing PDLT code deduplicates by source timestamp and requires consecutive 4h spacing.
Daily RAW_MANIFEST files preserve Git blob SHA and SHA-256 metadata.

datasets.research_role: Daily regime-context and future walk-forward validation lane.
datasets.caveat: The detailed inner schema should be verified from the owning collector before using component-level fields.

datasets.research_role: Weekly calibration and summary context, not a substitute for raw event-time observations.

15m.use: Study MAEVE timing, feature velocity, short-sequence persistence, cross-timeframe transitions, and entry/DCA microstructure.

1h.use: Primary candidate for action-clock modeling, matched controls, chronological OOS, and later frozen paper simulation.

2h.use: If useful, derive only from CLOSED 1h observations using time-valid transforms such as last value, change/slope, persistence, range, or disagreement. Never use future-containing resampling bins.

4h.use: Lower-noise action/confirmation candidate with an existing immutable forward cold-raw lane.

1d.use: Regime, risk-budget and trend-context layer rather than default trade clock.

genuine_gaps_not_yet_proven_filled: A complete locally materialized multi-year CFGI history across all native 15m/1h/4h/1d timeframes is not yet proven.
The mapping between the described ten public MAEVE/CFGI algorithm families and the currently observed component fields is not yet proven. Do not equate them silently.
Native 2h provider history is not yet proven.
Individual historical CFGI coverage for MAEVE-traded SOL/DOGE/BNB and other assets is not yet proven in the current inventory.
MARKET is absent from the targeted 1h historical event pull even though provider coverage metadata shows historical MARKET availability.
Recovered MAEVE component-field timestamps require leakage adjudication before entry-feature use.
A full repo-wide exact path/hash/coverage inventory of all legacy CFGI dumps remains incomplete.

next_actions.action: Continue repository-native discovery and classify each actual CFGI dataset as raw, derived, availability-only, targeted materialization, duplicate, or obsolete.
Join MAEVE timestamps to already available event-time-valid 1h and 4h context before requesting new provider history.
For Astra, compare native single-timeframe 1h and 4h models first, then hierarchical multi-timeframe fusion using 15m as research context and 1d as regime context.
Only after a documented gap matrix exists, test the CFGI API for the smallest missing symbol/timeframe/time-range cells.

Public copying of restricted raw provider values
Using after-the-action fields as entry features
Assuming a 15m-trained policy scales mechanically to 1h/4h/1d
